items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: There was only three hot men in town at that time. With me, Emil Christian and Lawrence Vega.

ctx.x: No, Vega died before that started.

Lawrence died. Was he good young? Yeah, he was good young. Was he a technician or a hot man? Hot man. Hot man. Very hot. Who's that? There was only three hot men there. Lawrence Vega. Lawrence Vega. There was only three hot men in town at that time. With me, Emil Christian and Lawrence Vega. The rest... Emil played trumpet a lot. Yeah, he played trumpet, yeah. Emil played trumpet, yeah. What year would that have been in, John? Oh, 1910. Do you remember... 1912.
Emmett Hardy? Yeah, Emmett Hardy. What style did he play?
